questions.question: What state does H|0⟩ produce?
questions.explanation: The Hadamard gate maps |0⟩ to the superposition state |+⟩ = (|0⟩+|1⟩)/√2.

questions.question: What is H·H (Hadamard applied twice)?
questions.explanation: H is its own inverse: H² = I. Applying it twice returns the qubit to its original state.
